title: Optimized Immunohistochemistry Protocol for Netrin-1 in Neural Tissue
author: Salameh, Nouel, et al.
materials: The following modifications to the protocol described above were necessary to obtain high-quality staining using the antibody produced by Abcam:1.Use PBS in place of PB2.Place the sections in citrate buffer in a water bath (100 °C) for 5 min, and then rinse them in PBS 3 times, 5 min each, on an orbital shaker at RT prior to the 1% SDS treatment.
We store the Abcam brand Netrin-1 antibody undiluted at −20 °C in single-use aliquots.

We also note that several steps specified by our protocol could potentially be modified without impacting the quality of the staining, and are simply the procedure of choice for our group. These include the secondary antibody used and the method of sectioning. We provide these details in order to maximize reproducibility. Furthermore, a complete and detailed description of our five-round protocol optimization procedure can be found in the Supplementary materials.

steps.title: Perfuse mice and fix tissue
steps.instruction: Perfuse each mouse sequentially with heparinized saline followed by 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA).

steps.title: Post‑fix brains overnight
steps.instruction: Remove brains and incubate them overnight in 4 % PFA at 4 °C.

steps.title: Section brains and collect sections
steps.instruction: Section brains at 35 μm using a vibratome and collect the free‑floating sections in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Perform SDS antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Place sections in 1 % sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) solution for 5 min on an orbital shaker at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Rinse sections in phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Rinse sections in phosphate buffer (PB) three times, 5 min each, on an orbital shaker at RT.

steps.title: Block sections
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in blocking solution consisting of 2 % bovine serum albumin (BSA) and 0.2 % Tween‑20 in PB for 1 h on an orbital shaker at RT.

steps.title: Dilute primary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute chicken anti‑netrin‑1 primary antibody (Novus NB100‑1605) 1:500 in the same blocking solution.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in the primary‑antibody solution for 4 nights (≈96 h) on an orbital shaker at 4 °C.

steps.title: Rinse after primary incubation
steps.instruction: Rinse sections in PB three times, 5 min each, on an orbital shaker at RT.

steps.title: Dilute secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute goat anti‑chicken Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody (Novus A‑11039) 1:500 in blocking solution.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in the secondary‑antibody solution for 1 h on an orbital shaker at RT (protected from light).

steps.title: Final rinses
steps.instruction: Rinse sections in PB three times, 5 min each, on an orbital shaker at RT.

steps.title: Mount sections with DAPI medium
steps.instruction: Mount sections on gel‑coated slides and cover‑slip with Vectashield Hard‑Set Mounting Medium containing DAPI (catalog #H‑1500).
